products.name: Notion Q&A
products.note: Knowledge base AI Q&A; workspace corpus access; permission-aware but broad exposure risk

profile_text.body:
Notion Labs is a for-profit startup founded in 2013 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company makes Notion, a workspace platform that the site describes as one tool for notes, docs, tasks, and databases. Its AI layer is built directly into that workspace rather than offered as a standalone product.

Notion AI is the company's embedded AI product, covering search, content generation, analysis, and chat within pages, docs, tasks, and databases. It includes Notion Q&A for querying a workspace's knowledge base, AI Meeting Notes for transcription and summarization, Enterprise Search with connectors to external tools such as Slack and Google Drive, and Custom Agents that can run multi-step automated work on schedules or triggers. Custom Agents run on a credit system priced at $10 per 1,000 credits, available as an add-on to Business and Enterprise plans. The site states that Notion AI enables HIPAA compliance through LLM providers' zero-retention APIs, and that customer data is not used to train models unless a user explicitly opts in, with contractual prohibitions placed on AI subprocessors as well.

The held facts show Notion Labs has 161 law-exposure entries tied to California, though no specific cases are recorded in the data. The company has a tracked presence on this site with two registered products, Notion AI and Notion Q&A, both accessible at the same product URL.
